'''Koba''' is a language spoken on the [[Aru Islands Regency|Aru Islands]] of eastern Indonesia.<ref>{{Glottolog|koba1240|Koba}}</ref> It is close to [[Dobel language|Dobel]], though mutual comprehension is low.
